description:
Transform your garage with these 15 DIY upgrades that make it warmer in winter, cooler in summer, quieter, brighter, and far more comfortable year-round. From garage door insulation and weather sealing to LED lighting, rubber flooring, sound panels, and a mini split install, these are the best garage upgrades for workshops, home gyms, offices, and more.
